description.value: Sardis Health Foods is a family-owned natural health and wellness store that has served the Sardis/Chilliwack area since 1988. The store employs certified Registered Nutritional Practitioners and carries an extensive range of natural health products through its membership in the Health First Network, Canada's largest independent health retailer group. A touring cyclist looking for supplements, natural remedies, or specialty health foods would find knowledgeable staff and a broad product selection here.
